contentPattern: Curated (static, hand-picked) featured story teasers. One row per card: cell 1 image (the first row may also hold a link to a Scene7/DAM/direct video, which adds a play button opening a modal player), cell 2 tag labels paragraph (e.g. '100 Years, People') + heading title + 'Learn more' link. The first card renders large with the image on top in the left column; the remaining cards stack in the right column as horizontal tiles with a thumbnail on the left.
